Here are my thoughts for the onboarding flow. A six step process to cover the basics. Step 1 — Bank identity Bank name, short display name, NUBAN code, country, HQ address, notification email. Currency, time zone, and regulatory authority auto-populate from country. Step 2 — Admin user The first user for this tenant. First/last name, email, temporary password (analyst is forced to change on first login). Optional fraud-report contact email. Step 3 — Additional team (optional) Add more users with roles up front — Analyst, Supervisor, Compliance Officer, Auditor. Or skip and add them later in user management. Step 4 — Channels Multi-select from the 9 standard channels: Teller, Internet Banking, Mobile Banking, ATM, POS, Portal, Card, Agency, Social Media. Bank picks the ones it operates. Step 5 — Operational policy Anti-fraud aggressiveness: Low / Medium / Aggressive (governs scoring strictness) Require supervisor approval on analyst decisions: yes/no Group related accounts: yes/no CTR threshold + cu…
